releaseNotes:
• New: Auto Screen Cast on Movies & Long Videos — prompts an un-bypassable Audio Cast Guard when opening Stremio, Nuvio, VLC, MX Player, Kodi, Plex, MPV, YouTube long videos (excluding Shorts/Home), or fullscreen/player-controlled Browser videos (excluding web articles & Social Media).
• New: No-Cancel Bypass — denying the Screen Cast prompt only allows retrying Screen Cast or exiting to Home.
• Optimization: Screen Cast turns OFF automatically ~1.8s after exiting the movie or video player.
